note: Integer clause, both polarities: TestSFlowV5UnknownEgressInterfaceIsZero requires output format 0 and value 0 for an unknown egress, and TestInterfaceCountersFromUnknownSpeed requires ifSpeed 0 and ifDirection 0 for unknown speed 0 and empty duplex (ifSpeed is a gauge, not a counter, so the integer clause governs it; ifDirection 0 also matches the if_counters 0 = unkown comment); TestInterfaceCountersFromExtended requires the exact 10 Gbit/s ifSpeed and the full-duplex code for a known link, so a known integer is never sent as the unknown 0. Counter clause: TestSFlowV5UnavailableCountersCarrySentinelEveryPoll requires exactly 0xFFFFFFFF for the four counters the kernel does not expose, and TestSFlowV5AvailableCountersNeverTurnUnavailable requires the real values, zero included, for the rest. All five units carry observed-red records; the ifSpeed half of the unknown-speed unit is proven by its exact assertion, not by its recorded break, and the unknown-to-0 mapping of a sysfs speed lives upstream in parseLinkSpeedDuplex, which no x-16 unit reaches.
